notes: All archive paths are relative. workspace/ paths restore underneath the repository root.
supplemental/ contains historical logs/configuration/analysis helpers; these are evidence, not a supported alternate implementation.
Older September local logs are preserved separately by category and are not new PoTal validation.
The archive also duplicates the small current measurement files committed to Git for a self-contained measurement bundle.
inventory.json itself is embedded at archive root and is intentionally absent from its own checksummed entry list.
excluded_from_git: All tensor captures (*.npz, *.npy), token dumps (*.i32), large historical cycle JSONL, and full build logs (in this archive).
models/gpt2-base/, models/llama3.2-1B/, model caches, build-*/ compiled files, IM2P artifact binaries/caches (not bundled).
.parity compiled binaries/libraries and miniature GGUFs; im2p-cache-build-scripts/bin generated mock commands (not bundled, left unchanged).
Raw Codex session logs and account configuration (not bundled).
